data.title: Super Bowl rematch kicks off NFL season as league expands global reach
data.description: LOS ANGELES - The most ambitious NFL season in history kicks off on Wednesday with a Super Bowl rematch, an unprecedented global schedule and a clutch of contenders plotting to dethrone the Seattle Seahawks.

data.title: US sanctions threaten to crush Iranian students' dreams
data.description: TEHRAN - She had planned to study psychology in Italy, but after US sanctions forced the suspension of an English exam required in order to make her dream come true, Iranian student Nikki cried for days.

data.title: Praying for rain as fires, haze plague Indonesian Borneo
data.description: PONTIANAK (INDONESIA) - Wildfires ravaging the Indonesian part of Borneo island are choking communities as far away as Malaysia with putrid haze, testing the resources and resolve of those having to endure them.

data.title: Indonesia reopens Jakarta airport, four others after Anak Krakatau ash clears
data.description: JAKARTA - Indonesia ​has reopened its main Jakarta airport and four other airports ​that had been closed due ‌to volcanic ash from a series of eruptions at Mount Anak Krakatau, transport minister Dudy Purwagandhi said in a statement on Tuesday.

data.title: Just a trim
data.description: Last weekend, I noticed my colleague returned to the office with a fresh haircut.

data.title: The Mall Group branches launch  Gourmet Mooncake Festival 2026
data.description: The Mid-Autum Festival season is bringing with it one of Bangkok's most anticipated culinary traditions. To mark this occasion, Gourmet Eats is holding the Gourmet Mooncake Festival 2026 at eight participating branches until Sept 25.

data.title: Guru's daily horoscope for Sept 8
data.description: The day of the week you were born on can reveal a lot... Read on.

data.title: Bissoli heroics give Buriram winning start
data.description: Buriram United made a winning start under interim head coach Emerson Pereira, beating Sukhothai 3-1 in the Thai League 1 opener at Thung Talay Luang Stadium on Sunday night.

data.title: 2nd Ajinomoto Young Chef  competition opens for entries
data.description: The Ajinomoto Young Chef 2026 competition with prizes worth more than 300,000 baht is now accepting entries until next Tuesday.

data.title: Brewing greatness
data.description: 'Thailand Coffee Fest" has returned for its 11th year under the theme "Made By All Of Us" to reinforce the idea that great coffee is not the work of a single person. Rather, it is the result of effort by many parties, from the production of coffee beans by farmers, brewing and serving to consumers. The event will take place at IMPACT Exhibition Center Hall 5-8, Muang Thong Thani, from Thursday to Sunday.

data.title: Panama Canal considering more cuts in transits due to El Nino
data.description: PANAMA CITY - The number of ships sailing through the Panama Canal could be cut further due to drought caused by the El Nino weather pattern, the new administrator of the waterway told AFP on Monday.

data.title: Flight data recorders recovered from Amazon cargo plane crash
data.description: MIAMI - Officials have recovered the flight data recorders from an Amazon cargo plane that overran the runway in Miami and slammed into two vehicles, killing five people, authorities said Monday.

data.title: US envoy sees 'movement' toward three-way talks with Russia, Ukraine
data.description: WASHINGTON (UNITED STATES) - A top US envoy on Monday touted progress in weekend discussions with Ukraine and Russia, raising the prospect of reviving three-way peace talks to end Europe's deadliest conflict since World War II.

data.title: Approved applicants warned to verify ID
data.description: More than 500,000 newly approved state welfare applicants have yet to verify their identities, putting their eligibility to receive benefits from Oct 1 at risk if they do not complete their so-called e-KYC by Sept 30.

data.title: PM Anutin maps path to resilience
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul on Monday emphasised the importance of strengthening the country's resilience from within to ensure steady advancement amid rapidly changing geopolitical and technological contexts.

data.title: Scam gang nets B800k from student
data.description: A 19-year-old university student was stopped from sending more money to a call-centre gang that had already taken more than 800,000 baht from her parents, the Anti-Online Scam Center (ACSC) said.

data.title: Comeback queen Zheng strikes again for US Open quarter-final berth
data.description: NEW YORK - Olympic gold medallist Zheng QinWen pulled off another incredible comeback Monday to stun six-time Grand Slam champion Iga Swiatek and reach the US Open quarter-finals.

data.title: Opposition wants budget cut further
data.description: Opposition MPs on Monday pressed the government to slash the 2027 budget by far more than the 11.16 billion baht already trimmed by a special committee, as the House of Representatives opened the bill's second reading.

data.title: Sondhi returns to street demos
data.description: Veteran activist and media mogul Sondhi Limthongkul on Monday unveiled a new political campaign under the banner "Take Our Thailand Back" to monitor the government's performance.

data.title: Israel moves to address  tourist issues
data.description: Israel is working with Thailand to address misconduct by Israeli tourists while seeking to prevent individual incidents from straining bilateral relations, Israeli Ambassador Alona Fisher-Kamm said.

data.title: Insurance plan to cover 30m households
data.description: The government plans to launch a national disaster insurance scheme in October covering 30 million households against floods, windstorms and earthquakes, with the state budgeting about 15.5 billion baht a year for premiums.

data.title: MP asks for more time to speak to DSI
data.description: People's Party Phuket MP Somchart Techathavorncharoen has asked the Department of Special Investigation (DSI) to postpone giving evidence in an alleged foreign-nominee inquiry until the end of this month.

data.title: New road to improve traffic in city's east
data.description: The Bangkok Metropolitan Administration (BMA) on Monday signed a 1.33-billion-baht contract with Prayoonchai (1984) Co Ltd for the first phase of a road linking Rattanakosin Somphot and Nimit Mai roads in eastern Bangkok.

data.title: Israel keen to step up cybersecurity ties with Thailand
data.description: Israel and Thailand should strengthen cybersecurity cooperation, Israeli officials and experts said at a Bangkok workshop yesterday on cyber threats, artificial intelligence and human capital.

data.title: PM appoints 3 data centre experts
data.description: Prime Minister Anutin Charnvirakul has appointed three experts to the Data Center Business Policy Committee, taking its membership to 21, a Government House source said.

data.title: Family seeks justice  after car crash
data.description: The family of elderly crash victims has sought help from Sai Mai Tong Rot ("Sai Mai Must Survive") after a former school director allegedly hit their pickup twice while drunk and tried to flee.

data.title: Far-right victory in Germany draws protesters in Berlin
data.description: BERLIN - Several thousand protesters gathered at Berlin's Brandenburg Gate Monday to decry the far-right Alterantive for Germany (AfD) after the party scored a breakthrough victory in a regional election the previous day.

data.title: UK PM denounces 'politics of poison' after anti-migrant protests
data.description: LONDON - British Prime Minister Andy Burnham urged his Labour Party lawmakers to stop the "politics of poison seeping into our streets" after demonstrators tried to block the arrival of migrants, a media report said Monday.

data.title: Eiffel Tower closed in row over women removed for Hindu group
data.description: PARIS (FRANCE) - The Eiffel Tower was closed on Monday because of a strike by staff over the removal of female colleagues during a visit by a Hindu religious group, workers and management said.

data.title: Lebanon says 12 killed in strikes as Israel vows to 'remove threats'
data.description: KFAR RUMMAN, Lebanon - Israel conducted a wave of airstrikes in south Lebanon, killing 12 people including women and children according to the Lebanese health ministry on Monday, in an intensification of violence after a weeks-long lull.

data.title: Israeli rubble-clearing in Gaza could erase 'atrocity crimes' evidence
data.description: GENEVA — An expert of the United Nations (UN) warned Monday that large-scale rubble removal in parts of Gaza under Israeli control risked erasing traces of "atrocity crimes", and preventing the recovery and identification of human remains.

data.title: Jaguar Land Rover to cut 4,000 jobs as European car sector hits skids
data.description: LONDON - Jaguar Land Rover said Monday that it would cut "around 4,000 roles over the next two years", or about ten percent of its global workforce, in a further blow to Europe's automobile industry.
